name: Ming Tsai
headline: Developer Lead building software ideas in the open.
bio: I'm a full-stack developer with a backend focus, based in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, with about 9 years of experience. I've been leading teams since 2020, first as Scrum Master and, since 2022, as Developer Lead at a large company in the beverage industry. I've worked across frontend, backend, architecture, DevOps and agile teams.
I hold a degree in Systems Engineering and a Master's in Cybercrime (Nebrija University, Spain, 2024).
Kreanto is my studio for side projects: what I'm building, what works, and what I archived.
